entries.claim_boundary: The axis statuses summarize different typed rows; they are not one cross-background mode. The ending is not a universal no-go and does not establish particles, scattering, unitarity, or complete quantum gravity.

dispersion.statement: The declared same-field counterflow family retains the j=1/2 Hamiltonian--Hopf quartet.

lee_wald.statement: The selected physical unstable block is nonradical; causality did not imply a healthy reduced pairing.

resonance.statement: The complete bounded compact-product zero locus remains open and is distinct from counterflow candidate selection.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: Row-specific bounded continuation results remain typed to their original laboratories.

causal_retarded.statement: No programme-wide causal second-order join is claimed.

smooth_secular.statement: Selected compact-product balanced representatives have finite exponential-polynomial secular corrections.

taub_maps.statement: The separate compact-product laboratory has a five-charge formal second-order criterion; it is not imported into the counterflow background.
